text:
maria: Heads-up — vendor PEN-2026 requested kickoff next Wed for external pen test. Need scope sign-off, RBAC change window, and KMS access notes. who owns intake?

owen: I can own intake + vuln triage. I'll assemble initial asset list today (app servers, auth, infra).

sam: tagging in on RBAC changes. Reminder: any role changes need CAB approval + a PR against infra-roles repo. No direct console edits.

lou: For KMS, vendor asked for decrypt access to test keywrap flows. We should never grant long-lived key access. Suggest using a short-lived cross-account role + session policy.

anna: Also confirm audit logging path. We currently forward control-plane logs to retention-90d; vendor requests 180d for audit evidence. That needs finance approval for storage costs.

secops-bot: New intake ticket created: REDWOOD-PT-58. Assignee: owen. Labels: pen-test, external, needs-scope.

owen: Putting initial checklist in REDWOOD-PT-58: asset list, threat-model notes, RBAC change window, KMS plan, log retention ask, and retest schedule proposal.

maria: Good. For RBAC window, prefer a weekend maintenance window + canary rollback policy. Can someone sketch the minimal role grant we'll need for vendor?

sam: Minimal proposal: create role pen-test/vendor-access with scoped permissions: Read on S3 buckets X,Y, List/Describe on RDS snapshots, and limited KMS GenerateDataKey* only for test-key. Attach SCP to limit source IPs to vendor bastion. PR template: https://git.redd/infra-roles/pull/xxx.

lou: Sample KMS session policy I'll propose to IAM:\n```\n{ "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [ { "Sid": "AllowVendorLimited", "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"], "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01" } ] }\n```

owen: Perfect. We'll pair that with a short-lived role assumption via STS (max session 1 hour). No persistent keys. Add a step to rotate access immediately after test.

anna: For audit logs: team, confirm which sinks we need to snapshot. Candidate: control-plane + auth + edge LB. infra-oncall can export a time-limited archive.

infra-oncall: I can create a 180d archive in a locked bucket for the pen-test team. Command I'll run:\n```\ngsutil cp -r gs://redwood-control-logs/2026-03-*/ gs://pen-test-archives/REDWOOD-PT-58/\n```
Will set ACL: project-private, no public access.

maria: Excellent. Next: timeline proposal in REDWOOD-PT-58 by EOD Friday. Proposed retest window 2 weeks after remediation closes. Who's owning remediation tracking?

owen: I'll track remediation. Suggest we use the "pen-test" board and add a custom field for severity and estimated effort. I'll add a weekly triage meeting slot on calendar.

sam: Quick checklist for triage meeting: reproduction steps, PoC, risk, owner, ETA, mitigation plan, and CI tests to prevent regression. Also flag any RBAC prod changes for a dry-run in staging.

lou: One more KMS gotcha — vendor wants to test wrapping/unwrapping with asymmetric keys. Our policy only allows symmetric GenerateDataKey. If they need asymmetric ops, we'll deny and document as "out-of-scope" unless product approves.

maria: Noted. We'll surface that in scope doc. If product signs off, we do an elevated review.

secops-bot: Reminder: scheduled CAB meeting Fri 16:00 UTC. Add PR links to the meeting notes.

own: I'll draft the scope doc and post here when done. If anyone has assets to add, ping me or append to REDWOOD-PT-58.

maria: thanks — appreciate the quick turn. Tagging @sam and @lou for RBAC/KMS PR review before CAB. :thumbsup:
